prerequisites.notes: Common or Coalition Application; the scholar application opens in the WashU Pathway after the admission application is submitted

application.notes: Finalists attend a series of virtual events in early spring and an interview in March. Applicants to more than one of the Danforth, Ervin and Rodriguez programs are allowed; the page does not say whether one student can hold more than one. Early Decision applicants may apply, but academic scholarships are not awarded until after the Early Decision commitment date. A third recommendation letter is recommended, not required. Study-abroad: awards count toward WashU-sponsored study abroad during the academic year.

renewal_rules.notes: Annually renewable for the duration of the degree program, provided students progress academically and uphold the program's character standards; the page gives no GPA or credit threshold.

stacking_rules.note: School words: if the scholarship covers your financial needs, you will no longer require need-based assistance; the page says the effect depends on each family's circumstances
